newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch money rates unmoved in becalmed market.
newsitem.headline: Dutch money rates unmoved in becalmed market.

text.p: Dutch money rates stayed pinned to Wednesday's levels in becalmed trade with dealers eagerly awaiting fresh impetus.
Today's announcement by the Dutch central bank of a new seven days special advances pact at an unchanged rate of 2.9 percent came as no surprise, dealers said.
Guilder rates were steady across the board, with call money quoting at an unchanged 3.12/3.25 percent bid-offer.
"I am hoping for some kind of new input to kick-start the market on Monday," one dealer said.
Friday is traditionally a slow day on the Dutch money market.
The guilder was trading at around 112.52 per 100 marks at 1420 GMT, up a touch from its 1215 fixing of 112.56.
